real_objective: Preserve exact full-grid S2 ideal-observer semantics while reducing the full 7,077,888-atom update kernel enough to re-evaluate the frozen S5 CPU-hour decision rule.

frozen_preflight.hash_method: local git-blob SHA1 reimplementation; no git command invoked

candidate_approaches.name: minimal implementation
candidate_approaches.description: Keep normalized float64 weights but fuse the gather and multiply path where possible.
candidate_approaches.evidence_it_would_produce: Lower update wall-clock with unchanged small-grid exactness certificate.
candidate_approaches.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: A temporary scratch optimization that only moves allocation cost while still touching the 56.6MB vector several times per update.
candidate_approaches.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Low leakage risk, but high risk of local performance polish without changing the real cost driver.
candidate_approaches.smallest_falsifying_test: Profile still shows normalization and scratch vector passes dominate update time.
candidate_approaches.expected_failure_mode: Wall-clock remains above the 24 CPU-hour decision line.

candidate_approaches.name: strongest shortcut explanation
candidate_approaches.description: Reduce runtime by downsizing the atom grid, changing the theta grid, moving the CPU-hour accounting line, or launching the particle-filter branch.
candidate_approaches.evidence_it_would_produce: Apparent tractability improvement without preserving the frozen exact full-grid contract.
candidate_approaches.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Any smaller-grid or approximate filter can match faster wall-clock under unequal access.
candidate_approaches.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: High governance risk: would violate the frozen theta grid, the no-particle-filter instruction, or the unchanged decision rule.
candidate_approaches.smallest_falsifying_test: Full-grid atom count differs from 7077888, decision_rule differs from projected_s5_cpu_hours <= 24, or complete_full_grid_run is false.
candidate_approaches.expected_failure_mode: Invalid tractability artifact; STOP and preserve failure rather than patching the decision line.

candidate_approaches.name: mechanism-faithful implementation
candidate_approaches.description: Move the exact posterior to float64 log-weights, add log likelihood by precomputed int32 class index in one in-place indexed add per update, and normalize only through logsumexp-shifted weights at query/entropy time.
candidate_approaches.evidence_it_would_produce: Before/after decomposed profile, <=1e-12 FactoredExactFilter-vs-ExactBayesFilter certificate on the 432-atom g=3 sub-grid, complete full-grid v4 benchmark, unchanged decision rule, and updated myopic-IG cost note.
candidate_approaches.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: Vectorized normalized weights may match correctness but should not match the expected single-pass update profile when normalization is removed.
candidate_approaches.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: Low if likelihood tables remain generator-derived, class indices stay precomputed from the frozen grid, and no thresholds or grid parameters change.
candidate_approaches.smallest_falsifying_test: Small-grid exactness delta exceeds 1e-12, posterior predictive differs from the old exact filter, v4 complete_full_grid_run is not true, or profile shows hidden 7M-vector passes remain.
candidate_approaches.expected_failure_mode: Exactness regression from log/weight conversion or query-time normalization bug.
